prompt:

The RIGHT number is bright amber and MUCH larger, at least twice the height of the left one, reading exactly: 68
Under both numbers, one short line of small off-white text, perfectly spelled: กิโลวัตต์

A single bright amber curve starts high on the left, runs flat for a short distance, then bends downward and decays toward the lower right, never reaching the bottom. Thin off-white axis lines along the left and bottom edges only. No tick labels, no numbers on the graph, no legend.

Flat solid colours only: very dark navy, warm off-white, bright amber, muted grey-blue. No gradient, no glow, no drop shadow, no 3D, no lens flare, no photographic texture. No car, no charging station, no cable, no logos, no brand names anywhere. Keep 8% clear margin left and right, 6% top and bottom — nothing touches an edge.
